claims.text: If vision loss occurs: intravitreal anti-VEGF (eg, ranibizumab, bevacizumab) or glucocorticoids, or laser, for retinal edema
claims.quote: If vision loss occurs, treatment of the retinal edema with laser or with intravitreal injection of glucocorticoids or antivascular endothelial growth factor medications (eg, ranibizumab, bevacizumab) may be useful.
